question: If the number of sides of a regular polygon is 18, then what is the measure of the interior angle of the polygon?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any regular polygon, the sum of an interior angle and its corresponding exterior angle is always 180°.

Exterior angle = 360° ÷ number of sides

⇒ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 18 = 20°

⇒ Interior angle = 180° − 20° = 160°

**∴ The correct answer is 160°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides of the regular polygon (n) = 18

**Formula Used:**

Measure of each interior angle of a regular polygon = (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n
